court_record.red_team: DECISIVE FINDINGS (all from primary XBRL / EDGAR / court records, not the scan's summary): (A) DSO is the scan's undoing. Built the 8-quarter series from companyfacts: AR/Rev DSO = 42d(Q1-23)->55->42->25->77(Q1-25)->81->93->104(Q4-25)->105.6d(Q1-26) — a secular CLIMB to an all-time record, ~equal to Culper's alleged 113d. The scan cited 'AR fell $22.5M sequentially' as exculpatory but that is the DOLLAR delta; scaled to sales DSO ROSE because Q1-26 revenue fell 17.7% sequentially (-0.3% YoY, flat). Culper's central metric is CONFIRMED, not refuted. Inventory/DIO also spiked (222M, ~586 days). (B) The channel-days data the scan called 'the empirical opposite of stuffing' (84->48d above safety stock) actually shows distributors carried 128 days TOTAL coverage in Jan and DESTOCKED to 90 by Mar — the destock IS why Q1 revenue missed; a channel working off 4+ months of inventory is consistent with prior over-stuffing, not against it. (C) LITIGATION FILED: Mazzarino v. ADMA, 2:26-cv-06918 (D.N.J.), ~Jun-15-2026; class period Aug-9-24..Mar-25-26; defendants CEO Adam Grossman, VC Jerrold Grossman, ex-CFO Brad Tade; sec 10(b)/20(a); lead-plaintiff deadline Aug-10-2026. The scan's record (same as_of) called this 'noise/solicitation' — it MISSED that a complaint was already on file. (D) SHORT INTEREST PRESSED to a 2-yr high: 19.1M(pre-Culper)->25.8M(Mar peak)->19.9M(May)->24.2M(Jun-30, ~12% float). Shorts are ADDING at the lows — directly contradicts the scan's 'buying the over-punishment of a refuted short' edge. DTC ~5.8 = low-moderate squeeze fuel. (E) ASCENIV growth DECELERATING: +51% FY25 -> +28% Q1-26 (a 23pt drop), and ~flat-to-down sequentially ($97.5M vs ~$100M+ implied Q4-25). The load-bearing firewall product is narrowing. (F) Culper's actual thesis (verified via web, not scan summary): 'Channel Stuffing, an Undisclosed Related-Party Distributor, and -3% Real Growth in 2025 vs +20% Reported' — alleges rebates+extended terms stuffed ASCENIV, rev inflated 40-76%, undisclosed related-party distributor, $50M insider selling over 3 yrs.
court_record.blue_team: CONCEDING what the scan got RIGHT (verified, and in two cases STRONGER than the scan claimed): (1) INSIDERS BOUGHT THE DIP. Pulled every 2026 Form 4 from raw XML: ZERO discretionary open-market selling after Culper or the guide cut. The only code-S sales were CEO Adam Grossman's 42k sh under a 10b5-1 plan entered Nov-14-2025 (pre-dates all bad news, sell-to-cover on $5.40 options) and the COO's 10k sh under a court divorce settlement. Against that, directors Jerrold Grossman (+31.4k sh @ $7.91-8.01 into the May low, ~$251k) and Steve Elms (~$217k) BOUGHT open-market. Net discretionary flow +$468k, purchases only. Culper's '$50M insider selling' is a 3-YEAR figure — stale, not fresh. The scan claimed the buyback but never pulled Form 4s; the red team CONFIRMS and strengthens the alignment. (2) The CFO 'departure' the May PR flagged is an ORDERLY RETIREMENT announced Feb-20 — BEFORE Culper (Mar-24) — with a consulting agreement; not a flight under a cloud. Downgrades that ambient flag. (3) Valuation is genuinely cheap and cap structure clean: EV/EBIT ~9.5x TTM, fwd EV/AdjEBITDA ~7.0x, fwd P/AdjNI ~10.3x; $0 preferred, no converts. Correction: NET-DEBT $59M (debt 72->197M via revolver), not net-cash as the scan implied — immaterial to EV at 0.3x. (4) Margin expansion is REAL and progressive (GM 53->71%, op margin 30->51% across 5 qtrs) on ASCENIV mix + FDA yield-enhancement, corroborated by $58M OCF — not an inventory artifact. (5) HONESTY CORE HOLDS: management DISCLOSED the elevated DSO, the extended-into-April receivables, the 128->90 channel destock, the flat YoY revenue, and WITHDREW long-term guidance. That is honest disclosure of an impaired quarter — CLEAN under our doctrine (a genuinely-impaired business that discloses its impairment is not a liar). The only UNVERIFIABLE piece is Culper's anonymous 'undisclosed related-party distributor'; the 10-Q related-party note discloses only Areth LLC (a $10k/mo office lease) and ADMA specifically denies any Grossman entity took title to product — so the falsifiable version of that claim is unsupported. UNVERIFIABLE != clean, but it is a single anonymous-sourced allegation against specific denials + absent from the note.
court_record.adjudication: DEPLOY-SMALLER (not KILL, not full DEPLOY). The scan's VERDICT direction (own it) survives but its MAGNITUDE and REASONING do not: this is not a clean liar-exclusion of a refuted short — it is a cheap, honestly-disclosed, impaired-but-real franchise with (i) a record and still-rising DSO that confirms rather than refutes Culper's core metric, (ii) a FILED civil-fraud complaint the scan missed, and (iii) shorts pressing to a 2-yr high. It is ownable because the honesty test passes (disclosure present, no takeaway-vs-data divergence), the business is genuinely profitable and cheap (~7x fwd EBITDA), insiders are buying, and the fraud's falsifiable core (related-party distributor) is unsupported. But the residual is a live binary (Mazzarino MTD + the Q2 DSO print) that the scan under-weighted. Cut the STARTER from ~$12k/1485sh to ~$8k/990sh at the SAME $8.08 GTC limit; harden the upsize gate to require DSO<=90d AND ASCENIV SEQUENTIAL growth AND no adverse litigation. Revised E[FV] $9.07 (was scan $11.40), reward:risk ~2.8:1.

court_record.decisive_finding_final: MODE-B ENTITY RESOLUTION (the scan's blind spot), re-verified with a dedicated forensic pass. Culper alleged an 'undisclosed related-party distributor.' Resolved from primary sources: (1) EXISTS: 'Genesis BioPharma Services' is the trade brand of GENESIS BIO-PHARMACEUTICALS, LTD. (NJ Div of Revenue ID 0100462566, incorporated 9/14/1990 — a real 35-yr-old company, Ramsey NJ; sibling Canada entity 0100843920). Its site (genesisbio.com, Wayback): NABP-accredited '3PL / life sciences logistics provider... emergency distribution... track and trace cold chain storage and distribution... primary source for Octaplas (Rx pooled plasma).' A real licensed wholesale drug distributor. (2) DISTINCT from the disclosed entity but operationally linked: ADMA discloses only 'GenesisBPS' (blood-processing EQUIPMENT vendor, Mahwah, ~$0.1-0.4M/yr). Genesis BioPharma Services (DISTRIBUTION/3PL) routes email to info@genesisbps.com and shares phone 201-488-1174 with Technomed/National Hospital Specialties (Jerrold Grossman's disclosed 'wholesaler of specialty biological and pharmaceutical products'). (3) ADDRESS = ADMA HQ: 465 (State) Route 17 (South), Ramsey NJ 07446 — the exact building ADMA leases from Areth LLC (Grossman-controlled). All three co-locate. (4) GROSSMAN CONTROL: Jerrold B. Grossman (ADMA Founder/Vice Chairman) is President of Genesis Bio-Pharmaceuticals and founder/CEO of Technomed/NHS and GenesisBPS (ZoomInfo/LinkedIn/MarketScreener + ADMA's own DEF 14A). (5) UNDISCLOSED: 'Genesis BioPharma Services' = ZERO hits in ADMA's FY2025 10-K, Q1-2026 10-Q, Mar-27 rebuttal, AND EDGAR full-text search across all filings. CORRECTION vs my interim read: ADMA's rebuttal denial is CATEGORICAL, not merely title-scoped. Verbatim (8-K EX-99.1, 3/27/2026): 'No entity owned or controlled by [the Grossmans] has ever distributed, taken title to OR OTHERWISE POSSESSED any of ADMA's products, WHETHER FOR RESALE OR OTHERWISE. ADMA confirms it has never sold any of its products to any entity controlled by the Grossman family.' This CLOSES the 3PL-handling-without-title loophole and makes the two positions BINARY & MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE: either Genesis genuinely moves ASCENIV (ADMA's categorical statement is FALSE) or the Products-page 'ASCENIV (10%, ADMA Biologics)' entry is an aspirational catalog listing of a sourceable product it does not actually distribute for ADMA (denial literally true). WHAT'S VERIFIED: existence + distinct-brand + address + Grossman-control + drug-distributor-function + not-named-in-filings. WHAT'S UNVERIFIABLE AT THE TOP BAR: whether ADMA's ASCENIV actually flows through Genesis — the 'lists ASCENIV' fact rests on search-engine CACHED renderings (Wayback HTTP-498-blocked, archive.today CAPTCHA-walled), NOT byte-level archived HTML, and no primary record shows product physically flowing. ADMA separately names its REAL ~73% distributors (BioCare + CuraScript/Priority; also Cencora/Healix) — none Grossman. NET: this is an UNRESOLVED BINARY with a fraud-tail, not a proven fraud — which supports WAIT (stand-aside) rather than AVOID/SHORT. To close it: a clean browser capture of archived genesisbio.com/products & /services, and the NJ DOH wholesale-drug registration for Genesis Bio-Pharmaceuticals Ltd; or the Q2-2026 10-Q / Mazzarino discovery quantifying any Genesis relationship.
